G-sign.summary: Lambda{a,b} = -{Lambda a,b} - (-1)^{|a|}{a,Lambda b} (C07 bracket of Def c1-bracket); Q S^V_2(xi) = Q S^perp_2(xi) = 0
G-sign.note: with this rule s^2 = 0 forces (sG)^(1)(x) = Lambda G^(1)(x) + {G^(0),S(x)} for degree-1 G, i.e. Lambda Ob^(1)(x) = -{Ob^(0),S(x)}; Lemma at-sformulas (ii) prints +{G^(0),S(x)} (derived with the derivation rule of the standard bracket (-1)^{|f|}{f,g}).  Degree-0 formula (i) is unaffected.
